title: Automatic upload uses GPS, but should not (extreme battery drain)
body:
I have no clue why you require GPS for background uploads, but it drains my battery to empty.

I see no reason for this behaviour and GPS is knonw to be the most heavy battery leaching process you can think off. All images are already GPS tagged by the iphone. Sooo no need to tag again, what also meens no need to calculate my position at all and no need to waste my battery!

If the phone is inside WLAN it need to upload the files - only than. WLAN on/off can be detected by the app without GPS.

The battery drain with this app is really extreme... ~800 images, 30% battery loss. I hope you can improve this and I hope it does not get empty before I'm back to a charger... :(
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
read : 

https://github.com/nextcloud/ios/issues/215

p.s. Your post is not correct, the system dot use the " traditional GPS" but the Cell radios

https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corelocation/cllocationmanager

> For example, setting the desired accuracy for location events to one kilometer gives the location manager the flexibility to turn off GPS hardware and rely solely on the WiFi or cell radios, which can lead to significant power savings.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Could be true - I'm not in the code. The app request GPS from me and the description does not tell anything about Cell radios. The battery drain is EXTREME and I still see no reason why this is needed. Only WLAN on/off is an indicator that should start the sync... normally. At least I do not have a 100GB LTE flat on mobile... :). I do not get the design idea why my movement should start a sync. Whereever I am, after the photo is taken it should be uploaded if there is wlan. if no wlan, wait until wlan comes up and than sync. To detect a wlan goes on and off you should not require my position... also if one kilometer inaccurate.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
What concerns me is the last part. My location does **not** change significantly when I make photos. However I expect that the app uploads them once I made them and I have seen it uploads more or less directly. I think it is not correct that I need to move 1km to get my photos uploaded, isn't it? If WLAN is active it will be uploaded immediately after the photo has been taken. Correct me if I'm wrong.

I think this info is _inacurrate_ than or at least misleading. It sounds like I need to move 1km to start the sync. Can you think of other wording for this?

Your sentence may be technically correct, but it is too technical. Hell - that I'm saying this... normally it cannot be enough technical details to understand how something works. May blame Apple the unfriendly way.

Found something that is much better info.

Why does the app stop uploading even when the Background App Refresh is turned on?

Because Apple only allows background apps 10 minutes of execution time before being forcefully suspended.
